scientific_integrity: The complete signature is an analytic theorem with a sufficient nonsharp weak-damping interval and an eventual fixed-parameter correction defined by finitely many Fourier coefficient signs. No claim of independent certification or global historical priority is made.
scientific_limitations: Only evenly spaced grids of even size are covered.
The all-size interval is sufficient, not claimed sharp.
At general damping, the finite-size onset and finite Fourier-sign correction are implicit.
The theorem supplies no statement about arbitrary point configurations or nonintrinsic distances.
title: Exact weak-damping inertia and an eventual half-negative law for powered geodesic circle kernels
